sentences.text: ORDER This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of first bail relating to FIR No.67/2022, dated 03.3.2023, registered at Police Station Singhpur District Satna for the offence under Sections 376(1), 302, 201 of IPC.
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant - Raja @ Atul Ahirwar is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
